notes.rnav_rule: Denominator = common equity overhang only (options/RSUs/ITM warrants). Preferreds (incl. STRK) and convertible debt are subtracted as claims in the numerator. We do not assume converts or STRK convert.
notes.yahoo: Do not use Yahoo impliedSharesOutstanding for dilution — it is mostly dual-class consolidation, not warrants/options/RSUs.
notes.mstr_converts: MSTR convertible notes stay as debt MTM; STRK stays as preferred at market. Neither is assumed to convert into common. Strategy's assumed_diluted_shares_outstanding that adds those shares is ignored.
notes.asst_warrants: ASST PIPE Traditional Warrants @ $27 (post-split) expire 2026-09-15 (1y after S-3ASR effective 2025-09-15). Deep OTM — excluded from rNAV denominator; likely expire worthless.

asst.policy: rNAV uses effective diluted common (basic + RSUs/options and any ITM warrants). OTM warrants stay in gross only. SATA is a preferred claim in the numerator — not diluted here.

mstr.policy: rNAV uses basic + employee options + RSU/PSU only. Converts and STRK are not assumed to convert — debt / preferred claims in the numerator at market.
